name: Gin Mare
region: Costa Dorada (south of Barcelona), Catalonia, Tây Ban Nha
distillery: Distillery in a 19th-century chapel in a former fishing village on the Costa Dorada (Vilanova i la Geltrú per backlog) [cần kiểm tra]
owner: Global Premium Brands (per 2010 article) [cần kiểm tra chủ sở hữu hiện tại]
production: Citrus macerated for over a year in earthenware jars
Each botanical distilled separately, then blended
history: 2010 | Coe Vintners announced as UK importer; described as 'the new super premium gin' (Harpers, 16 June 2010)
serve_official: 50 ml Gin Mare + 200 ml premium tonic over ice, orange twist and rosemary sprig (retailer quoting brand)
notes: Described as the first gin to use Arbequina olive. Sold in 700 ml/750 ml/1.75 L per retailer listings. ABV differs between sources (42.7% vs 42.3%) [cần kiểm tra]. Launch year not found in sources (backlog says 2008).
